summary:
Implementation Plan:
1. Remove the calculator trigger button and modal import from CBTTestView.tsx (exam area).
2. Add a dedicated 'Save to Revision Deck' / 'Saved' toggle button in the bottom action bar next to 'Mark & Next' in CBTTestView.tsx with real-time feedback toast/indicator.
3. Enhance the Revision Deck (RevisionVaultView.tsx) with:
   - Clear question removal with confirmation and bulk clear option.
   - Dedicated 'Analyse Question' action on each saved question that generates in-depth AI & Google Search derivations with KaTeX step-by-step math.
   - Caching generated analyses locally so students can review them offline anytime.
